meta.name: pinme-share
meta.description: Use this skill when the user wants to share, publish, or upload a static result through PinMe, especially by generating a static HTML share page for a PinMe project link, deployed full-stack app, Codex conversation summary, report, file, demo, or any 分享/发布/上传分享页 request that should end with `pinme upload`.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 一键生成静态分享页并上传到 PinMe
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速将项目或报告生成可分享的静态页面并上传。
copy.tagline_en: Generate and upload a static share page to PinMe with one command.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create a shareable static page from your project or report and upload it.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会帮你把项目链接、对话总结、报告或文件打包成一个漂亮的静态 HTML 分享页，然后通过 PinMe 上传并返回一个公开链接。
howto.when: 当你要求分享、发布或上传某个结果（如项目链接、对话总结、报告、演示等）时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个项目链接做成分享页并上传。
say.note: Claude 会创建 HTML 页面并上传，返回链接。

say.text: 总结这次对话并生成一个分享页面。
say.note: Claude 会提取关键信息，生成分享页并上传。

say.text: 把这个报告文件上传分享。
say.note: Claude 会为文件创建分享页并上传。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will package your project link, conversation summary, report, or file into a polished static HTML share page, upload it via PinMe, and return a public URL.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to share, publish, or upload a result such as a project link, conversation summary, report, or demo.

say_en.text: Turn this project link into a share page and upload it.
say_en.note: Claude creates an HTML page and uploads it, returning a URL.

say_en.text: Summarize this conversation and create a share page.
say_en.note: Claude extracts key info, generates a share page, and uploads it.

say_en.text: Upload this report file for sharing.
say_en.note: Claude creates a share page for the file and uploads it.
